news.titleEn: Tankers defy sharp escalation of Iranian attacks to keep crude oil flowing through Strait of Hormuz
news.conclusionEn: At least 30 vessels were hit around Hormuz in October, the worst month of the Iran war, as Brent closed the month above $117 a barrel.
news.conclusionZh: 10月霍尔木兹至少30艘船遇袭创纪录，布油月末收于117美元上方
news.whyEn: Oil near its wartime high feeds straight into inflation, central-bank rate decisions and fuel costs for every importing economy.
news.whyZh: 油价逼近战时高点，直接推高通胀和各国加息压力，进口国燃料成本上升
news.detailEn: Ship attacks doubled from 15 in September to at least 30 in October, injuring at least 16 seafarers, according to IMO data. Brent rose about 13% in the month and settled near $117.64, just shy of March's wartime high of $118.35. Hormuz exports still averaged 11.1 million barrels a day in October thanks to a tanker shuttle system, but flows slipped to 7.3 million bpd in the last week. Supertanker day rates have jumped from about $249,000 to over $900,000, so freight now eats 20%-30% of delivered crude costs.
news.detailZh: 国际海事组织数据显示，10月遇袭船只从9月的15艘翻倍至至少30艘，至少16名船员受伤。布伦特原油当月上涨约13%，收于约117.64美元，逼近3月战时高点118.35美元。依靠在阿曼湾驳运的「接驳」模式，10月霍尔木兹日均出口仍有1110万桶，但最后一周降至730万桶。超大油轮日租金从约24.9万美元飙升至90万美元以上，运费已占原油到岸成本的20%-30%。

news.titleEn: AI boom hits a wall on Wall Street as OpenAI cuts fundraising target while Meta gets a credit warning over its cash flow, spending and monetization
news.conclusionEn: OpenAI cut its latest funding round from $30 billion to $20 billion and lowered its valuation from $1.4 trillion to $1.25 trillion amid the AI stock selloff.
news.conclusionZh: OpenAI融资目标从300亿降至200亿美元，估值下调至1.25万亿
news.whyEn: When the leading private AI company has to shrink its raise, it signals investors are getting pickier about AI valuations across both private and public markets.
news.whyZh: 头号AI独角兽缩减融资，说明一二级市场对AI估值开始变得挑剔
news.detailEn: The cut, first reported by the Financial Times, came as some investors reduced their allocations during a week of steep tech losses. Even at $1.25 trillion, OpenAI would remain the most valuable private company ever, and $20 billion is still one of the largest rounds on record. The move lands alongside S&P's credit warning on Meta, adding to doubts over how quickly huge AI spending can turn into profit. Watch whether other AI start-ups face down rounds or tougher terms in coming months.
news.detailZh: 该消息最早由《金融时报》报道，部分投资者在科技股大跌的一周里下调了认购额度。即便估值1.25万亿美元，OpenAI仍是史上最值钱的私营公司，200亿美元也仍是有记录以来最大的融资之一。此事与标普警告Meta信用前景同时发生，加深了市场对巨额AI投入多快能变成利润的怀疑。接下来要看其他AI初创公司是否也会被迫降价融资或接受更苛刻条款。

news.titleEn: Meta outlook revised downward by S&P on cash flow and capex concerns
news.conclusionEn: S&P cut Meta's credit outlook to negative from stable while keeping its AA- rating, citing heavy AI capex and negative free cash flow.
news.conclusionZh: 标普将Meta信用展望下调为负面，AA-评级暂维持
news.whyEn: It is a rare warning on a megacap tech balance sheet and could raise borrowing costs for AI data-center buildouts funded by debt.
news.whyZh: 罕见针对科技巨头的信用警告，可能抬高靠举债建AI数据中心的成本
news.detailEn: Meta posted negative free cash flow of about $2.1 billion in the third quarter, its first ever, and guided full-year capex to $135-145 billion. S&P said Meta's ability to monetize AI is more limited than peers' and that data-center leases could push leverage above its downgrade threshold by 2027. A negative outlook means a downgrade is possible within roughly two years but is not imminent. Meta disagreed with the assessment, while its stock fell about 15% in October, its worst month in four years.
news.detailZh: Meta第三季度自由现金流约为负21亿美元，为公司首次转负，并预计全年资本支出1350亿至1450亿美元。标普认为Meta将AI变现的能力弱于同行，且数据中心租赁可能在2027年前把杠杆推过降级门槛。「负面展望」意味着未来约两年内可能降级，但并非迫在眉睫。Meta表示不认同该判断；其股价10月下跌约15%，为四年来最差月份。

news.titleEn: A simple explainer of the massive crypto heist at Binance
news.conclusionEn: The FBI confirmed on Saturday that North Korea's TraderTraitor unit carried out the record $6.3 billion hack of Binance.
news.conclusionZh: FBI确认朝鲜黑客组织制造了币安63亿美元的史上最大盗案
news.whyEn: Official attribution raises sanctions and laundering-tracing stakes, and the heist revives questions about how safe centralized crypto exchanges are.
news.whyZh: 官方定性将牵动制裁和追赃，也让中心化交易所的安全性再受质疑
news.detailEn: Hackers drained just over $6.3 billion from Binance in about 20 minutes on Thursday afternoon. Binance and its partners have frozen roughly $3 billion of the stolen crypto, and the exchange says it will reimburse affected customers. The FBI said TraderTraitor, the same group behind last year's $1.5 billion Bybit theft, is converting the loot mainly into Ether before further laundering. Expect pressure on exchanges and DeFi swap services to block the remaining funds.
news.detailZh: 黑客在周四下午约20分钟内从币安盗走逾63亿美元加密资产。币安与合作方已冻结约30亿美元被盗资产，并表示将赔付受影响用户。FBI称作案者为TraderTraitor——去年15亿美元Bybit盗案的同一团伙，赃款正主要换成以太坊以便进一步洗钱。预计各交易所和去中心化兑换服务将面临拦截剩余资金的压力。

news.titleEn: China's manufacturing PMI softens, high-tech sector maintains expansion
news.conclusionEn: China's official manufacturing PMI fell to 49.3 in October from 50.1, slipping back into contraction.
news.conclusionZh: 中国10月制造业PMI降至49.3，重回收缩区间
news.whyEn: A weaker Chinese factory sector weighs on global demand for commodities and raises the odds of fresh stimulus from Beijing.
news.whyZh: 中国制造业走弱拖累大宗商品需求，也提高了政策加码的可能
news.detailEn: The reading missed expectations of about 50 and was the lowest since July, with both production and new orders weakening. Statisticians blamed demand pulled forward before the National Day holiday and a complex international environment. High-tech manufacturing held up at 51.3, while small and medium firms were under more pressure at 47.5 and 48.4. The non-manufacturing PMI also dipped below 50, to 49.7.
news.detailZh: 该数据低于约50的市场预期，为7月以来最低，生产和新订单双双走弱。统计部门将其归因于国庆假期前需求提前释放以及复杂的国际环境。高技术制造业PMI仍保持在51.3的扩张区间，而中型和小型企业分别为48.4和47.5，压力更大。非制造业PMI也降至49.7，跌破荣枯线。

news.titleEn: Germany, France, Italy and Spain: Where was inflation highest in October?
news.conclusionEn: October inflation jumped to 5.4% in Italy and 3.4% in France, held at 4.9% in Spain and eased to 2.8% in Germany.
news.conclusionZh: 10月意大利通胀跳升至5.4%，德国回落至2.8%
news.whyEn: The figures keep a December ECB rate hike firmly on the table and point to a hot eurozone print on November 4.
news.whyZh: 数据让欧洲央行12月加息仍有可能，11月4日欧元区通胀或偏高
news.detailEn: Energy costs rose in all four big economies, but national policies split the outcomes, with a fuel-tax cut pulling German inflation down from 3.3%. Italy's jump from 4.2% was the biggest surprise, and some forecasters now see eurozone inflation near 4%. The ECB held its deposit rate at 2.5% on October 29 but said a December hike is still very much live. Growth is weak at 0.4% in the third quarter, sharpening the trade-off for policymakers.
news.detailZh: 四大经济体的能源成本都在上涨，但各国政策导致结果分化，德国因燃油减税使通胀从3.3%回落。意大利由4.2%跳升最出人意料，部分机构已把欧元区通胀预期上调至4%左右。欧洲央行10月29日维持2.5%存款利率不变，但表示12月加息「仍很有可能」。第三季度经济仅增长0.4%，央行面临的两难更加突出。

news.titleEn: Houthi forces claim six attacks on Saudi airports, oil facilities
news.conclusionEn: Yemen's Houthis claimed missile and drone strikes on Ras Tanura, Abqaiq, Rabigh and two Saudi airports, despite Saudi-Iran talks in Tehran.
news.conclusionZh: 胡塞武装称袭击沙特多处炼厂和机场，无视沙伊会谈
news.whyEn: Abqaiq and Ras Tanura are core nodes of Saudi oil supply, so any damage would add to an already tight market.
news.whyZh: 阿布盖格、拉斯坦努拉是沙特石油供应核心，一旦受损将加剧供应紧张
news.detailEn: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree said the targets included the Ras Tanura and Rabigh refineries, an Aramco site in Abqaiq, airports in Riyadh and Dammam, and a military headquarters in Najran. There was no independent confirmation and Saudi authorities did not say whether the sites were damaged. The claims came days after Saudi, Turkish, Pakistani and Iranian officials met in Tehran and pledged to settle differences through dialogue. The attacks helped push Brent to its highest level since late April.
news.detailZh: 胡塞发言人萨雷亚称，目标包括拉斯坦努拉和拉比格炼油厂、阿布盖格的阿美设施、利雅得和达曼机场以及纳季兰的一处军事总部。上述说法未获独立证实，沙特也未说明设施是否受损。就在几天前，沙特、土耳其、巴基斯坦与伊朗官员在德黑兰会面并承诺通过对话解决分歧。这些袭击推动布伦特油价升至4月下旬以来最高。

news.titleEn: US approves potential $2.1 billion sale of scarce Patriot missiles to Ukraine
news.conclusionEn: The State Department approved a possible $2.1 billion sale of 500 PAC-3 MSE Patriot interceptors to Ukraine, funded largely by European partners.
news.conclusionZh: 美国批准向乌克兰出售500枚爱国者导弹，约21亿美元
news.whyEn: It shows Europe paying for US weapons as the main way Ukraine gets air defense, and is a boost for Lockheed Martin's order book.
news.whyZh: 体现「欧洲出钱、美国供货」的援乌模式，也利好洛克希德·马丁订单
news.detailEn: The package includes PAC-3 Missile Segment Enhancement interceptors plus spare parts and logistics support. Canada, Germany and Norway will help pay through a multinational program, along with money from the EU's Ukraine Support Loan. Congress has about 30 days to review the sale, and production of these scarce interceptors can take years. That means Ukraine is unlikely to see the missiles quickly despite heavy Russian air attacks.
news.detailZh: 该套方案包括PAC-3 MSE拦截弹以及备件和后勤支持。加拿大、德国和挪威将通过多国采购计划出资，另有资金来自欧盟的援乌贷款。国会约有30天审查期，而这种稀缺拦截弹的生产可能需要数年。因此，尽管俄罗斯空袭猛烈，乌克兰短期内恐难拿到这批导弹。

businessTips.explanationEn: Landed cost is the full cost of getting a product to your door: purchase price plus freight, insurance, duties, fees and handling. Managers who only watch the purchase price miss the costs that can swing the most. In volatile times, freight and insurance can turn a profitable product into a loss-maker. Tracking landed cost per unit lets you price, source and negotiate based on reality.
businessTips.explanationZh: 到岸成本是把商品真正送到你手上的全部成本：采购价加上运费、保险、关税、各项手续费和装卸费。只盯采购价的管理者，往往会漏掉波动最大的那部分成本。在动荡时期，运费和保险可能让一个原本赚钱的产品变成亏损。按单位追踪到岸成本，才能基于真实数字去定价、选供应商和谈判。
businessTips.exampleEn: Today's oil story is a live example: supertanker rates jumped from about $249,000 to over $900,000 a day, so freight now makes up 20%-30% of delivered crude costs. A small importer whose supplier price is unchanged could still see margins vanish if shipping doubles.
businessTips.exampleZh: 今天的原油新闻就是现成例子：超大油轮日租金从约24.9万美元涨到90万美元以上，运费已占原油到岸成本的20%-30%。对一家小进口商来说，即使供应商报价没变，只要运费翻倍，利润也可能被吃光。

businessTips.explanationEn: A down round is when a company raises money at a lower valuation than its previous round. It dilutes existing shareholders more, can trigger anti-dilution protections for earlier investors, and may hurt employee morale if their options lose value. A related signal is a cut in the target raise or valuation before closing, which tells you investor appetite has cooled. Founders can soften the blow by raising before cash runs low and keeping burn under control.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「降价融资」是指公司以低于上一轮的估值融资。它会让老股东被稀释得更多，可能触发早期投资人的反稀释条款，员工期权缩水也会打击士气。另一个相关信号是在交割前就下调融资目标或估值，说明投资人的热情在降温。创始人应在现金还充裕时提前融资、控制烧钱速度，以减轻冲击。
businessTips.exampleEn: OpenAI trimmed its target from $30 billion to $20 billion and its valuation from $1.4 trillion to $1.25 trillion, though still well above its March round. For a small startup, a 10%-20% valuation cut mid-raise is a cue to extend runway, prioritize revenue and check what anti-dilution terms earlier investors hold.
businessTips.exampleZh: OpenAI把融资目标从300亿降到200亿美元、估值从1.4万亿降到1.25万亿，不过仍远高于3月那一轮。对小型创业公司来说，如果融资途中估值被砍10%-20%，就该延长现金跑道、优先做收入，并核对早期投资人手里有哪些反稀释条款。

businessTips.explanationEn: Besides the rating itself (like AA-), agencies such as S&P and Moody's attach an outlook — positive, stable or negative — showing where the rating is likely headed over roughly one to two years. A negative outlook is an early warning, not a downgrade, but bond prices often react right away. A stronger signal is CreditWatch, which means a change could come within about 90 days. Watching outlooks helps bond and stock investors spot balance-sheet stress before it becomes a headline downgrade.
businessTips.explanationZh: 除了评级本身（如AA-），标普、穆迪等机构还会给出「展望」——正面、稳定或负面，表示未来约一到两年评级可能的走向。负面展望是早期预警而非降级，但债券价格常会立即反应。更强的信号是「列入观察名单」（CreditWatch），意味着约90天内可能调整。关注展望能帮助债券和股票投资者在降级成为头条前，提前发现资产负债表的压力。
businessTips.exampleEn: S&P kept Meta at AA- but moved its outlook to negative because AI capex and data-center leases could push leverage past its threshold by 2027. A bond investor might ask for a slightly higher yield on new Meta debt, while a stock investor would watch free cash flow in the next few quarters.
businessTips.exampleZh: 标普维持Meta的AA-评级，但把展望调为负面，原因是AI资本支出和数据中心租约可能在2027年前把杠杆推过门槛。债券投资者可能会对Meta新发债券要求略高的收益率，股票投资者则会紧盯接下来几个季度的自由现金流。
